stories.title: ‘I created my mom and talk to her’: AI ghosts and deathslop are changing the way we mourn
stories.summary: AI-generated tributes and chatbots that simulate conversations with dead people are changing how some people mourn. Experts cited in the report fear these “AI ghosts” and other synthetic memorial content could lead more people to grieve in isolation.

stories.title: Phones are the new cigarettes: why restaurants are discouraging and even banning them
stories.summary: Some restaurants are discouraging or banning phone use in an effort to get diners to connect with one another. Approaches include asking customers to hand over their phones at the door in exchange for incentives such as a free bottle of wine.
